Biography

Consort Mirena is the second queen of King Aldric.

item.title: King Aldric
item.description:
Biography

Aldric is the 42nd monarch of Northwaldia. Known as the “Sage of the Terminal,” he is famous for his unconventional method of ruling his domain entirely via plain-text files and shell scripts.

He shares his throne with Queen Elysia, who oversees the kingdom’s cryptographic defenses. Unlike her husband, Elysia prefers a more “Debian-stable” approach to governance, leading to lively midnight debates in the royal court.

Early Life

Aldric’s birth in the royal house of Northstar is often treated as the beginning of the modern Northwald succession.

Conflict with the South

Currently, Aldric’s forces are engaged in a long-standing border dispute with South Isles. This war began not over land or gold, but over a disagreement regarding the default init system for the regional network.

item.title: Queen Elysia
item.description:
Biography

Queen Elysia is the co-ruler of Northwaldia. Known throughout the realms as “The Keeper of the Keys,” she manages the kingdom’s vast cryptographic archives and ensure the stability of the realm’s core services.

While her husband, King Aldric, focuses on rapid development and experimental “rolling” policies, Elysia is the voice of caution. She famously refused to update the kingdom’s primary firewall for three years, arguing that “if it isn’t broken, it’s secure.”
